html:
The Socialist Republic of Macedonia was a federal unit of Yugoslavia, proclaimed by the Partisan assembly known as ASNOM on 2 August 1944, the anniversary of the Ilinden Uprising.

It was the first time Macedonians had a state of their own. In 1945 the new government adopted a standard Macedonian language and alphabet, based on central dialects, and in 1967 the Macedonian Orthodox Church declared itself independent. Bulgaria and Greece disputed the very idea of a separate Macedonian nation. Skopje grew as a capital and was rebuilt after the 1963 earthquake. The republic became independent in 1991 as the Republic of Macedonia.
sum: The Socialist Republic of Macedonia was a federal unit of Yugoslavia, proclaimed by the Partisan assembly known as ASNOM on 2 August 1944, the anniversary of the Ilinden Uprising.
